literal: Let one guard self-control as a treasure; prosperity greater than that there is not for life.
translation: One should guard self-control as a precious treasure; there is no greater wealth than that for a person's life.
modern: அடக்கத்தை ஒரு சிறந்த செல்வமாகக் கருதி அதைக் காக்க வேண்டும்; மனித உயிருக்கு அதைவிடச் சிறந்த செல்வம் வேறு எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of self-control. The poet advises us to protect and nurture self-restraint (அடக்கம்) as if it were our most precious wealth (பொருள்). The second line reinforces this by stating that there is absolutely no greater source of true prosperity or elevation (ஆக்கம்) for a human life (உயிர்) than possessing this single virtue.
